title: Amendment record for archkeel validate --against widening
$comment: Binds the recursive contract tree and canonical original before/actual after baseline policies. Legacy v1 records authorize contract-only comparisons.

before_digest.description: SHA-256 of the --against revision's contract, in the canonical form archkeel.ir.codec.contract_bytes writes. When that revision holds no contract at the configured path, archkeel.ir.codec.absent_contract_digest: the SHA-256 of a NUL byte, "no contract at " and the contract's repository path, which no canonical contract can have (AD-104).

after_digest.description: SHA-256 of the contract being validated, in the same canonical form.

decided_by.description: Free text: who decided this widening is allowed.

rationale.description: Free text: why the widening was decided.
